text: piyaṅkarasuttaṃ [819] ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā anuruddho sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme . tena kho pana samayena āyasmā anuruddho rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya dhammapadāni bhāsati . [820] atha kho piyaṅkaramātā yakkhinī puttakaṃ evaṃ tosesi mā saddamakarī piyaṅkara bhikkhu dhammapadāni bhāsati apica dhammapadaṃ vijāniya paṭipajjema hitāya no siyāti . [821] pāṇesu ca saññamāmase sampajānamusā na bhaṇāmase sikkhema susīlyamattano api muccema pisācayoniyāti . sattamaṃ
